eps.ov: In a lonely city where all the inhabitants have been erased by mysterious machines, Renge encounters a team of girls who have been fighting the machines. She cooks them a meal.

eps.t: Canned Mackerel Italian-style Tomato Hot Pot Together
eps.ov: Now that Renge has joined the group's ranks with her powerful weapon, Yuri feels capable of confronting the Goliath, a huge machine, and continuing to advance.

eps.t: Unforgettable Canned Crab and Canned Mackerel Chirashi Sushi
eps.ov: With Yuri having passed away, the team must decide what to do next. The photos being posted on social media may offer a clue.

eps.t: Rich and Warm Corn Beef Miso Ramen
eps.ov: A sudden snowstorm forces the girls to take refuge in a school.

eps.t: Wishing On Mackerel, Oyster, and Egg Zosui Soup Kuzushi Kiritampo Style
eps.ov: The relationship between Erika and Hinageshi becomes strained. A duel between the big sister and the gamer begins.

eps.t: Pool Videos, Summer and Shanghai-style Squid Yakisoba
eps.ov: The team makes videos by the pool to prove on social media that they are humans.
The team fights a large group of Wild Hunt threatening what appears to be Citron's group.

eps.t: Chocolate Bars Once the Rain Stops
eps.ov: Renge meets Suzuran and discovers that she may not be who -- or what -- she thinks she is.

eps.t: Laughed All Night and Put Lots of Secret Ingredients in a Surprisingly Tasty Curry
eps.ov: Suzuran's group prepares to move to Citron's settlement.

eps.t: One More and a Missing Can
eps.ov: The team chase Yuri into a station and discover more than they can wrap their head around.

eps.t: Cooking Together With the Untouchable Girl
eps.ov: Hinageshi hacks the facility's AI, forcing it to explain its role.
Balor approaches. It's up to the copies -- and Renge -- to protect the survivors.

eps.t: Ending on an Ochazuke Buffet with Everyone Around
eps.ov: The girls continued their fierce battle in "Everyone's Ochazuke Buffet."
